headline.measured_note: not enough data yet to compare sessions with and without an optimizer. The dollar savings above are estimates.

budget.name: month
budget.lever: The biggest leak is repeated tool results, about $4.50 this month (estimated). Fixing it is the largest change available.

leaks.title: Repeated tool results
leaks.advice: Add this line under [optimizers] in config.toml. It applies from your next session.

leaks.title: Noisy tool output
leaks.advice: noise_normalizer is on. See what it saved under Optimizers.

leaks.title: Prompt cache misses
leaks.advice: Cache misses happen when the start of a request changes between turns. Avoid editing early context mid-session.

optimizers.quality: No regression detected locally. Trove checks retries, tool errors and re-fetches; it does not prove output quality.

recommendations.title: Try hook_large_output in shadow mode
recommendations.detail: Tool results in this repo average 4.0 large outputs per session over 6 sessions, and a go_test test setup was detected. The large-output hint suggests the trove_run tool for noisy commands; in shadow mode it only counts.
recommendations.label: estimated
recommendations.name: hook_large_output

recommendations.title: Try hook_quiet_commands in shadow mode
recommendations.detail: A go_test test setup was detected and tool results here average 4.0 large outputs per session. Quiet flags on test commands in shadow mode estimate the saving.

recommendations.name: hook_quiet_commands

recommendations.title: Try hook_read_limit in shadow mode
recommendations.detail: This repo is in size bucket L and sessions read about 30 files each. Line limits on big reads in shadow mode estimate what they would save.

recommendations.title: Try hook_repeat_read in shadow mode
recommendations.detail: Sessions here re-read a file already read about 3.0 times each (over 6 sessions). Repeat-read prevention in shadow mode counts how many reads it would have avoided.

recommendations.title: Try output_trimmer in shadow mode
recommendations.detail: Over your last 6 sessions in this repo, tool results averaged 4.0 per session over 6,000 bytes. The output trimmer keeps failures and a summary and shortens the rest; in shadow mode it only estimates what it would remove.
